stories.title: Jags acquire Eagles DT Davis in blockbuster; 3rd trade to boost defense
stories.summary: The Jaguars traded a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to the Eagles for defensive tackle Jordan Davis on Monday.

stories.title: Nacua (knee, toe) likely to hit IR; Rams to explore 'all avenues' before trade deadline
stories.summary: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua is likely going on injured reserve due to an MCL/PCL sprain as well as turf toe, according to coach Sean McVay.

stories.title: Tigers SS Kevin McGonigle, Reds 1B Sal Stewart win MLB's rookie of year awards
stories.summary: Detroit Tigers shortstop Kevin McGonigle, 22, won the American League Rookie of the Year award Monday night in a televised presentation, moments before Cincinnati Reds first baseman Sal Stewart, 22, was honored as the National League Rookie of the Year.

stories.title: Sources: USMNT's Poch favored for United job with Carrick exit imminent
stories.summary: United States coach Mauricio Pochettino is the favoured candidate to replace Michael Carrick as Manchester United manager, sources have told ESPN.

stories.title: Cards QB Minshew has UCL injury, sources say; WR Wilson (neck) out for year
stories.summary: Cardinals quarterback Gardner Minshew probably will need season-ending surgery on his right UCL, sources told ESPN. Michael Wilson, Arizona's top wide receiver, is also out for the season because of a neck injury.
